    • ColumnInfo

      public ColumnInfo(EntityInfo<?> entityInfo, String propertyName, String columnName, Class<?> columnType, boolean isKey, Expression selectExpression, Expression insertExpression, Expression updateExpression)
      Constructs a new ColumnInfo.
      Parameters:
      entityInfo - the entity information
      propertyName - the property name
      columnName - the column name
      columnType - the column type (permit null)
      isKey - true if key, false otherwise
      selectExpression - the expression to be used to create SELECT SQL (permit null)
      insertExpression - the expression to be used to create INSERT SQL (permit null)
      updateExpression - the expression to be used to create UPDATE SQL (permit null)
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - entityInfo, propertyName または columnName が null の場合
